title: Cost-aware SLIs and request-shape tracing for analytics ingestion pipeline
creator: Maya Liu
description: Add cost-aware SLIs and tracing that captures request shape (sequence length, batch size, KV cache hits) for the Console analytics ingestion path. Goal is to enable granular alerting and dashboards that correlate unit cost drivers with SLI degradations and to reduce alert noise by sampling and enrich traces with feature flags and tenant metadata.
acceptance_criteria: New SLIs published in SLI catalog: ingest_p99_latency_by_request_shape, ingest_unit_cost_per_10k_events, ingest_error_rate_by_tenant
Distributed traces include enriched tags: tenant_id, sequence_len_bucket, batch_size, kv_cache_hit=true|false, ingestion_path_version
Dynamic sampling policy implemented: always sample p99+ traces and error traces; 1% baseline for success traces; 5% for high-cost request shapes
Dashboards created in Grafana: Cost vs Latency heatmap, Top 50 tenants by unit cost, Request-shape SLO burn rate panel; links added to the Console SLO page
Alerting rules adjusted to use request-shape-aware SLIs and suppress pager alerts for noisy low-impact tenants
Unit and e2e tests added; perf regression threshold 5% on ingest tail latency

comments: 2026-01-18 - Maya Liu: Kickoff meeting notes: prioritize p99 latency by request shape and cost metrics. Agreed on bucketing thresholds for sequence_len: 0-128,129-512,513-2048,2049+.

2026-01-25 - Adrian Cole: Prototype trace enrichment landed in branch feat/trace-enrich. Initial tags include tenant_id and seq_len_bucket. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/analytics-ingest/pull/542

2026-01-28 - SRE (Jordan Park): Proposed sampling policy to always capture errors and p99 traces; baseline 0.5% for small shapes and 3% for large shapes. Concern about storage cost for high sampling—requested quant estimate.
2026-01-30 - Maya Liu: Uploaded cost model spreadsheet to Confluence; initial estimate shows 18% storage increase if we sample 5% of all large-shape traces. Decided to iterate with targeted canary.
2026-02-02 - Adrian Cole: Implemented dynamic sampler controller MVP; canary flag 'obs_cost_aware_sampling' ready. Next: dashboard templates and alert tuning.
rollout_plan: Canary rollout: enable trace enrichment and sampling controller behind feature flag for 10% of ingesters for 72 hours; evaluate p99/increase in trace storage; expand to 50% then 100% if no regressions. Update alerts at 50% stage.
trace_sampling_policy: Errors: 100%; Latency>p99: 100%; High-cost shape: 5%; Medium-cost: 1%; Low-cost: 0.5%; Adaptive cap per-tenancy to avoid hot tenants exceeding storage budget
logging_retention_changes: Keep enriched request logs at full resolution (30d) for high-cost tenants; aggregated logs (histograms/rollups) for others at 90d. Will coordinate with compliance for PII filtering.
notes: Trade-offs: richer traces improve RCA but increase storage/cost; decided on tiered sampling and per-tenant caps to balance observability and economics. Follow-up action to propose quota controls for tenants generating >25% of trace volume.
